description: Async. Create a new knowledge-base item for the brand. Returns { operationId, status } — poll get_job until state=completed. If description or tags are omitted, PostKing auto-generates them from the content. For contentType='json', content must be valid JSON — this tool validates client-side before calling the API. Typically takes ~15–30 s.

content.description: The full content body. Must be valid JSON string when contentType='json'.

contentType.description: Content format: 'text' for prose/markdown, 'json' for structured data.

description.description: Optional short description. If omitted, PostKing auto-generates one from the content.

isGlobal.description: Mark as account-wide knowledge (shared across all the user's brands)

name.description: Human-readable name for the knowledge item (e.g. 'Brand Voice Guidelines').

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering (e.g. ['brand', 'voice']). Auto-generated if omitted.

name: knowledge_create
